a_independent.description: No dependence: onsets homogeneous in the time no event is ongoing; the only history effect is non-overlap.

b_fragmentation.description: Fragmentation: after ANY event ends, both streams' onset hazard is raised 6x, peaking 40 ms after the END (about 20-60 ms).

c_onset_rhythm.description: Onset-locked rhythm: each stream's onset hazard is raised 4x, peaking 110 ms after its own previous ONSET, whatever that event's duration.

d_cross_swr_to_nonswr.description: Cross-stream coupling: non-SWR onsets raised 5x, peaking 50 ms after an SWR-coupled event ENDS; nothing the other way.
